title: No One in the Seat
hook: Nobody is coming to sit beside you.
scene: The permit in the glovebox says a licensed driver is supposed to be in the passenger seat, five years of driving behind them, watching what you do. There is no one at the counter to enforce that and no one left to ask. Gracie is where that person would sit. You are nineteen years old with a permit, an empty office behind you, and two hundred and eighty miles between you and your mother, and the only thing holding the standard up now is you.
debrief: A permit means supervised. There is no one to supervise you, so the standard is yours to keep.

source.teaching_target: Name the empty seat. A permit requires a licensed supervisor. There is none. She keeps the standard anyway.
